name: dodojo-skills
description: Open agent skills from dodojo: dodojo-travel, trip pages checked for your dates with a map and real photos, and dodojo-game, games you play on one page.

plugins.name: dodojo-skills
plugins.description: dodojo-travel: plan a trip or a day out as a phone-first page with checked hours and tickets, a map of each day and real photos. dodojo-game: make a game people play on a phone or a computer, with the game first, a computer opponent and every move kept. Both save into dodojo or stand on their own.
